name: track_preparer
description: Prepares a music collection for the Volumio library in one run: unpacks archives, splits CUE+image albums, converts formats to FLAC or MP3, trims silence, embeds covers, merges multi-disc albums, sorts files into Artist/Album by tags and writes ReplayGain tags. Source files are never changed.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: One button turns a folder of unsorted music into a clean, tagged library in a second folder: unpacks .zip, .iso and .iso.wv archives (Cyrillic names from Windows archives are restored), splits CUE+image albums (several cue files in one folder, side A/B images, images stored in parts, cue files for already split tracks), converts lossless formats to FLAC and lossy ones to MP3 VBR V0, trims silence, finds and embeds covers, merges multi-disc albums (cd1/cd2 folders and discs marked in the album name, such as Album CD2), cleans file names, sorts everything into Artist/Album by tags and writes ReplayGain 2.0 track gain. The input files are never modified; a progress page with start and stop is served on the local network.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.9.0: discs marked in the album name (CD1, - Disc 2, (Disc 1)) are merged into one album with continuous track numbers
